question: Per WPIL Limited (NSE: WPIL)'s 4 November 2025 earnings call, what did it say about its MOU with its partner, and how will EBITDA margins progress?
answer: Per the 4 Nov 2025 (Q2FY26) earnings call, WPIL said its margin profile is 16-20% and that it has been maintained (the prior quarter was a blip due to acquisitions/one-time expenses). Nothing in the held data mentions an MOU with a partner.
working: Claim 621981 (ebitda_margin, guidance): "Our margin profile is between 16 to 20 and that is something we have maintained. The last quarter was a blip because of certain acquisitions which happened and certain one-time expenses which were captured." Claim 621986/621991: Q2FY26 consolidated EBITDA margin 18.87%, standalone 20.01%. No MOU-related claims or chunks found.
missing: not in data: any mention of an MOU with a partner in the WPIL 4 Nov 2025 earnings call.
